question: Compare the lost-link settings of the Matrice 30T, Matrice 4T, EVO Max 4N, and Matrice 210 V1.

intake.reason: Need guidance from manuals/incidents on lost link behavior and automatic actions (return, hover, land, reconnect) for the listed models.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance claims that when a hazard occurs, operators should try to reestablish control link and follow predetermined loss-of-control procedures, with no fixed time to regain VLOS and actions governed by the aircraft’s capabilities. Manuals provide device-specific implementations: Matrice 4T auto-initiates Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH under suitable conditions; Matrice 210 V1 notes Failsafe RTH after >3 seconds, returns to the last Home Point, and distinguishes Smart/Low Battery/Failsafe RTH, with GPS weakness potentially preventing Home Point return. Incident reports: there are no usable evidence for incident reports (unverified accounts) in the approved collection.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states the remote PIC must “regain VLOS as soon as practicable” and notes there is no fixed time interval; if VLOS cannot be regained, predetermined procedures must be followed.
